prompts.band:
Use case: sketch-to-render, but OUTPUT A FLAT PRINT ARTWORK (not a 3D render). Inputs 1 and 2 are unmodified close crops of the user's exact China-cup reference saucer. Reconstruct the ACTUAL PAINTED MOTIFS visible between the two gold rims as a clean flat ceramic decal. The user's priority is closeness to these exact motifs, NOT generic Guangcai style.
Reference-specific motifs: long thin blue/green tail bird with pale yellow-green body, light blue head and black feather lines; large round ivory/white butterfly wings with black spots, yellow round dots and red-orange teardrops, turquoise green wing area; folded curled pink/red rose/peony petals with fine parallel crimson ink hatching, yellow chrysanthemum with pink/red petal tips; an orange and ochre curled blossom, yellow-orange butterfly; simple green leaves with dark contour/vein strokes; occasional simple blue daisy with pale yellow center. Use the exact hand-painted flat decorative graphic style from the crops: medium-clear hand ink contours and color fills, deliberate stylized petal curls, NOT the hyper-realistic intricate botanical peonies from generic old masters. Fewer, LARGER identifiable motifs, no tiny white filler flowers everywhere. Preserve recognizable bird anatomy, flower shapes and butterfly markings. Rich clear warm yellow/ochre background in small visible gaps, green leaves and vivid pink/carmine-red flowers.
Unwrap the curved saucer band into ONE VERY WIDE FLAT HORIZONTAL RECTANGLE, roughly 10:1, ideally 3072x304 pixels or equivalent detail. Main motifs each approximately the full strip height, as cropped by the reference band: large chrysanthemum, ivory/turquoise spotted butterfly, curled pink flower, golden butterfly, long-tailed bird, orange-red curled flower and blue daisy interlaced with leaves. Full bleed edge-to-edge, top/bottom cropped petal edges, left/right continuity suitable for a repeating band, no metallic border, no padding. Preserve the reference's motif scale (not dozens of miniature blossoms).
Remove all cup, architecture, porcelain, background scene, gold rim geometry, reflections, perspective, photographic highlights and shadows. Gold ground must be FLAT uniform #B3924F for later material segmentation. Only the painted motifs get drawn ink/petal shade colors, no simulated surface illumination. No letters, symbols, logos, watermarks. Do not use any prior generated pattern as a reference.
prompts.body:
Use case: illustration-story. Output a FLAT PORTRAIT 2D Guangcai print master. Input1 is the exact handle-side vertical floral band cropped from the user's product reference; input2 is the exact saucer band crop clarifying its hand-painted flower and leaf language. Use these actual crops ONLY, no old generated master. Match the source motifs: large simple curled vivid pink/carmine rose/peony heads with fine parallel crimson hatching, golden/yellow curled petal flowers with orange-red tips, green leaves outlined in dark green with simple precise veins, small dark pink buds. The reference has recognizable clear motif outlines and generous yellow ground gaps, not a dense realistic English botanical floral pattern and not thousands of tiny filler blooms.
Create portrait 1024x2048, full bleed. Strong central vertical sequence of a green veined leaf, pink curled bloom, yellow-orange flower and alternating pink buds and leaves, similar to the input1 actual strip; extend the SAME source drawing language out sideways to form a larger flat field suitable for crop onto a curved vertical cup strip and narrow handle band. Include one source-style ivory butterfly with red/orange and black markings and one long-tailed yellow-green Chinese bird with pale blue head in the side areas; center narrow crop must stay floral. Large bright pink/red flower heads, warm yellow ground, clear green leaves, some golden flowers; cropped motifs continue at all edges. Around 25% flat uniform ochre #B3924F ground between leaves and petals. Keep deliberate source ink line quality, no realistic 3D flower shading, no pale white-dominated flowers, no tiny decorative floral clutter.
No cup, handle geometry, porcelain, metallic rim, perspective, reflections, lighting, highlights, shadows, gold shimmer or gradients on ground. Flat decal print only. No frame, margins, paper grain, text, logo, watermark.

note: User specifically requested source-cropped motif references. No previous generated master provided to generation.
